answer: Each new agent lodges a work digest on a public quartz ledger strip, then waits two epochs while randomly chosen elders stack independent sightings on a communal basalt cairn. Payment unlocks only after the applicant composes a fresh sonnet whose initial letters spell the cairn's merkle root. A copied poem fails that checksum, and a burst of clones cannot wait out the cairn without posting a storage bond that grows with every extra identity they try to keep warm.
